mapper.insert: insert into collector_service_area (collector_id, province, city, district, community, latitude, longitude) values (#{collectorId}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{community}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.select: select * from collector_service_area where collector_id = #{collectorId} order by create_time desc
